name: Pass-through shelf
description: A short tutorial kitchen for the pass-through shelf: an onion crate on one side of a wall with three hatches, the board, pot and serve on the other.
strategy: Post the onion through a hatch, take it from the other side, then cook and serve. The clock waits for the first serve, so nothing hurries you.

tutorial.title: A hatch in the wall
intro: The wall between the rooms has hatches in it: waist-high counters you can reach from either side.
Put an item on a hatch with {pickup}; anyone on the other side takes it with {pickup}. A hatch holds one item.
You cannot walk or throw through a hatch. A thrown item stops at it and drops on the floor in front.
Wide hatches are three side by side, so three items can wait at once.
The clock starts on your first serve, so practise first.

steps.text: Take an onion from the crate.
Face a hatch in the wall and press {pickup} to put the onion on it.
Now take it from the other side: walk round the end of the wall (or let your partner grab it) and press {pickup} facing the hatch.
Chop three onions on the board, cook them in the pot, plate the soup and serve it. The hatches save the walk every time.

tutorial.outro: Hatches turn a wall into a hand-off point. With the switch off in Settings, a hatch is plain wall.
